entry.summary:
<div class="callout-note" role="note">
<p>From July 2024 to June 2026, work to modernise government digital services took place under the umbrella of the Service Modernisation Roadmap.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Work to modernise government digital services continues through the <a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/digital-government/digitising-government-programme-dgp/digital-target-state">Digital Government Target State</a>.</p>
</div>
<h2>What the plan was&nbsp;</h2>
<p>The Service Modernisation Roadmap was a strategic All-of-Government vehicle to coordinate and accelerate New Zealand’s service modernisation journey. The roadmap aligned cross-government effort and helped drive an improved and more unified customer service experience for digital government services. This put New Zealand’s people and business at the centre of government services.</p>
<p>Improving the customer service experience of digital government services was a key portfolio priority for the Minister for Digitising Government, <abbr>Hon</abbr> Judith Collins.</p>
<p>The roadmap was part of a wider digitising government approach to:</p>
<ul>
<li>move faster to improve digital service delivery to New Zealanders</li>
<li>work smarter as a system to innovate and do digital differently</li>
<li>reduce costs and maximise the value coming from agency digital projects.</li>
</ul>
<p>The multi-year roadmap was refreshed annually.</p>
<h2>How it went</h2>
<p>The 2025 to 2026 roadmap had 51 initiatives from 4 system leads and 8 operational agencies — <abbr>ACC</abbr>, Ministry of Education, Ministry of Justice, Ministry of Social Development, Inland Revenue, <abbr>NZTA</abbr>, Health <abbr>NZ</abbr> and <abbr>MBIE</abbr>. The initiatives were grouped into the following areas:</p>
<ul>
<li>customer service experience</li>
<li>reusable digital components</li>
<li>data, digital and security foundations</li>
<li>doing digital well.</li>
</ul>
<p>The Government Chief Digital Officer (<abbr>GCDO</abbr>) led an annual process to refresh the roadmap in line with government priorities.</p>
<p>The second iteration of the roadmap (version 2) had a stronger focus on areas that made a step-change difference to system-wide digital service delivery. The GCDO wanted to work smarter as a system to innovate and do digital differently, increasing&nbsp;standardisation and coordination over time.</p>
<h2>Where can I find out more?</h2>
<p><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/digital-government/strategy/strategy-summary/decommissioned-service-modernisation-roadmap">Decommissioned Service Modernisation Roadmap</a></p>
